caveats: Pool counters count physical RPC input slots/attempts; NTRN logical children and canonical transfers are different units.
Refresh successes require a completed batch with at least one accepted unique native input; successes, exhaustion and deadlines overlap.
Accepted refresh inputs are deduplicated within one batch only and include repeated exact-hash idempotent RPC retries, not necessarily new insertions.
Attempts, accepted inputs and signature reuses update before batch completion; interior boundaries can contain carry-in/out and abandoned partial work.
Signature reuses count avoided dispatches even when later rejected. Verification timing samples are per pass, including reused-signature prechecks.
Stage times are overlapping wall residence and preemption/waiting, not exclusive CPU. The block signature executor does not count pool verifier dispatches.
Per-canonical-transfer stage values are rate-normalized estimates: interior stage wall/s divided by full-window proof-checked canonical TPS, not an exact matched cohort.
One pair does not establish repeatability or peak capacity. Offered load must independently exceed canonical throughput by five percent for capacity eligibility.

execution.resource_scope: Docker stats valid for Desktop VM; host /proc-derived harness thread/cgroup metrics excluded from interpretation

acceptance_original.semantics: proof correctness, run completion, signed-run physical quantum, requested/effective generator batching, ingress capacity, chain capacity, validator canonical cleanup, and reproducibility are independent acceptance dimensions

load_level_acceptance_original.semantics: load_validation proves the offered level only; it does not establish chain capacity

strict_reuse.semantics: prebuilt images; stable validator container/image and daemon PID/kernel start ticks across setup and load

delivery.semantics: Diagnostic collated candidates in generator measurement interval, not independently canonical-filtered; timings overlap. Pending epoch does not prove ready work. Published probe lower bound does prove completed publication before probe.
